dismiss-label.description:
Accessible name of the dismiss button. Override for localization; the
default English word is the component's only built-in text.

When to use: whenever the document language is not English.
When NOT to use: do not put the message here; use the default slot.

dismissed.description:
Reflected state: true once the toast has left. The timer, the dismiss
button, Escape and the action set it; the page may set or clear it.
While true the host stays in the document but renders nothing and leaves
the accessibility tree. Clearing it shows the toast again with its full
time.

When to use: show a toast again, or close it from the page.
When NOT to use: do not read programmatic changes as dismissals;
`ki-dismiss` reports only the timer and the person.

dismissible.description:
Shows the dismiss button, a ghost `ki-icon-button` named by
`dismiss-label`. Escape still dismisses a focused toast without it.

When to use: keep it on unless the toast leaves on its own and the page
offers no other way to read it again.
When NOT to use: do not turn it off on a toast that waits for the person.

duration.description:
How long the toast stays, in milliseconds, before it leaves on its own;
`0` keeps it until it is dismissed. Ignored (treated as `0`) when the toast
holds an action or its tone is `danger`. Unset, or not a finite number of
zero or more, it is 5000. The time stops while the pointer rests on the
toaster, while focus is inside it, or while the page is hidden, and
continues with what was left. Changing it restarts the time.

When to use: give a longer message more time.
When NOT to use: do not shorten it below what a person needs to read the
message.

heading.description:
Optional bold first line, inside the live region. Empty strings render no
heading. It is a `strong` element, never a document heading.

When to use: a short label for the event ("Changes saved").
When NOT to use: do not use it for page structure.

queued.description:
Output-only state written by an enclosing `ki-toaster`: true while the
toast waits for a place. A queued toast renders nothing, is absent from
the accessibility tree and its time does not run. Authors do not set it;
the toaster overwrites it.

tone.description:
Picks the icon and its ink, and the live-region urgency: `danger` exposes
`role="alert"` and never leaves on its own; `neutral`, `info`, `success`,
`warning`, absent and unrecognized values expose `role="status"`. The
surface and the text look the same in every tone. Unknown values render
neutral.

When to use: choose the tone that describes what happened.
When NOT to use: do not use tone for emphasis; a lasting failure belongs
in `ki-alert`.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-motion-distance-sm.description: Motion travel distance sm (4px): small slide/settle offsets.

--ki-motion-duration-medium-1.description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.medium1 (250ms). onmars: MarsUI moderate step (240ms, 2x the 120ms base).

--ki-toast-backdrop-filter.description: filter used by the toast component behind its surface, taken whole: none by default; a theme may blur here (document 2, rule 6; issue #342).

--ki-toast-bg.description: color used by the toast component for its flat raised surface (issue #353: surface-raised, the deprecated alias of surface.s1, so the step itself).

--ki-toast-bg-image.description: image used by the toast component over its background color: none by default; a theme may paint a gradient here (document 2, rule 6).

--ki-toast-border.description: color used by the toast component for its hairline edge (issue #353).

--ki-toast-border-width.description: dimension used by the toast component for its hairline edge.

--ki-toast-danger-icon.description: color used by the toast component for the danger tone icon: the tone lives in the icon alone (issue #353).

--ki-toast-dismiss-fg.description: Foreground of the toast dismiss glyph.

--ki-toast-fg.description: color used by the toast component for the heading ink (issue #353).

--ki-toast-gap.description: dimension used by the toast component between icon, text, action and dismiss button (issue #353: 12px).

--ki-toast-heading-font-family.description: Font family for the toast heading (document 2, rule 6; issue #347). Override it to give toasts their own heading typeface.

--ki-toast-icon-size.description: dimension used by the toast component for the tone icon.

--ki-toast-info-icon.description: color used by the toast component for the info tone icon: the tone lives in the icon alone (issue #353).

--ki-toast-message-fg.description: color used by the toast component for the message ink (issue #353).

--ki-toast-neutral-icon.description: color used by the toast component for the neutral tone icon: the tone lives in the icon alone (issue #353).

--ki-toast-padding.description: dimension used by the toast component for its padding (issue #353: 12px).

--ki-toast-radius.description: dimension used by the toast component for its corners (issue #353: 16px).

--ki-toast-shadow.description: shadow used by the toast component for its elevation (issue #353: e4). The only theme-controlled shadow in the toast's box-shadow (document 2, rule 6).

--ki-toast-success-icon.description: color used by the toast component for the success tone icon: the tone lives in the icon alone (issue #353).

--ki-toast-warning-icon.description: color used by the toast component for the warning tone icon: the tone lives in the icon alone (issue #353).

--ki-toast-width.description: dimension used by the toast component for the widest a toast gets (issue #353: 22.5rem).

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 2.

--ki-typography-line-height-para.description: semantic dimension for typography line height para.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-body-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.

--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.

component.description:
A short, transient message about something the person just did, shown
without blocking the page. It leaves on its own after its time, which stops
while the person points at the toaster, works inside it or is away from the
page; a toast with an action, or reporting an error, waits for the person.

ki-dismiss.description:
Fired once when the toast leaves because its time ran out
(`reason: "timeout"`), the person used the dismiss button (`"button"`),
pressed Escape inside it (`"escape"`) or activated its action
(`"action"`), after it is hidden and focus has been handed on. Not
cancelable. When to use: remove the element, or record that the message
was seen. When NOT to use: do not expect it for programmatic `dismissed`
changes.

action.description: Wrapper around the `action` slot, rendered only when it holds content.

heading.description: Optional bold first line, rendered only when non-empty.

icon.description: The tone icon, drawn by the component in the tone's ink.

message.description: Message wrapper around the default slot.

toast.description:
The flat surface: fill, image, edge, radius, padding,
elevation and backdrop filter.

slots.description: Message text. It lives inside the live-region boundary.

action.description:
At most one action, as a `ki-button size="sm" variant="ghost"`.
Its own click handler runs, then the toast leaves (`reason: "action"`). A
toast holding an action never leaves on its own. When NOT to use: a response
the person cannot skip belongs in `ki-dialog`.
